note_quote: 讀取 slot 與 local binding 都不複製或修改輸入；left += 1 重新綁定 immutable integer，只有針對 height item 的 assignment 才會寫回。
source_quote: Reading height[left] retrieves an element without removing it. Assigning that value to left_height binds a local name; it does not copy the list. Python integers are immutable: left += 1 computes an integer value and rebinds left, rather than changing an integer stored inside height. An assignment targeting an item such as height[left] would write that item; no such assignment occurs here. The input remains available to the caller. Python assignments, numeric types.
failure: note「只有針對 height item 的 assignment 才會寫回」與context「只有 item assignment 才是另一種操作」帶排他性。來源僅說 item assignment 會寫入及展示程式沒有這種操作，沒有聲稱它是所有修改 list 的唯一機制。若限定為本程式 reads/bindings，保留輸入的重建成立；排他一般化不可接受。
counterexample: 合法起始height=[2,5]，height.append(1)也修改原list而沒有item assignment；排他措辭超出所鏈來源。
scope: 不否定展示程式的 input-preservation。不是執行到的程式 bug。
